payload.core_mechanism_summary: Finds min/max x and y, then computes f(3)=2*max_i(max_dist_x+max_dist_y), and for k>=4 f(k)=2*(max_x-min_x+max_y-min_y).
payload.rationale: Solution is not DP but uses simple iteration and formulas; forced to choose from DP subtypes. dp_2d_state suggested by rule with low confidence.
